lines.zh: 铠甲撞在一起，我的脚步很沉。
lines.en: My armor knocks together, and my steps fall heavy.

lines.zh: 我拖着剑走，剑尖在石头上刮出火星。
lines.en: I drag my sword, its tip striking sparks from the stone.

lines.zh: 没有头，我照样知道该往哪走。
lines.en: Headless, I still know which way to go.

lines.zh: 每一步都像从墓里踩出来。
lines.en: Each step feels like climbing out of a grave.

lines.zh: 铁靴碾过枯叶，声音很空。
lines.en: Iron boots crush dead leaves with a hollow sound.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但从不迷路。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but I never lose the way.

lines.zh: 颈口的黑洞里，风在打转。
lines.en: Wind circles inside the dark hollow at my neck.

lines.zh: 剑鞘空着，我提着剑走。
lines.en: The sheath is empty; I carry my blade in hand.

lines.zh: 月光照在铠甲上，照不到我的脸。
lines.en: Moonlight rests on my armor, never on my face.

lines.zh: 我沿着旧路走，路还认得我。
lines.en: I follow the old road, and the road still knows me.

lines.zh: 我站着，铠甲里的骨头偶尔响一声。
lines.en: I stand still, and bones rattle once in a while.

lines.zh: 没有头颅，我也能听见远处的鼓声。
lines.en: Without a head, I still hear drums in the distance.

lines.zh: 剑插在土里，我扶着剑柄。
lines.en: My sword stands in the dirt, and I lean on its hilt.

lines.zh: 这具铠甲生锈了，我却没散。
lines.en: This armor has rusted, yet I have not fallen apart.

lines.zh: 我想不起自己的名字，只记得誓言。
lines.en: I cannot recall my name, only the oath.

lines.zh: 风穿过颈口，发出笛子一样的声音。
lines.en: Wind passes my neck and makes a flute-like note.

lines.zh: 我数着头顶飞过的乌鸦。
lines.en: I count the crows that fly overhead.

lines.zh: 阴郁钥匙刃在我腰边轻轻震。
lines.en: The Somber Key Blade trembles lightly at my hip.

lines.zh: 我低头，才想起低不了头。
lines.en: I try to bow and remember I have no head.

lines.zh: 营火的光照过来，我往后退了退。
lines.en: Campfire light reaches me, and I draw back a little.

lines.zh: 我在等一个敢靠近的人。
lines.en: I am waiting for someone brave enough to approach.

lines.zh: 铠甲的缝里长出了青苔。
lines.en: Moss has grown in the seams of my armor.

lines.zh: 我握着剑，像握着一根拐杖。
lines.en: I hold my sword like a walking stick.

lines.zh: 远处有马蹄声，可惜不是我的马。
lines.en: Hooves sound far off, but they are not my horse.

lines.zh: 我抬手摸了摸颈口，那里是空的。
lines.en: I raise a hand to my collar; there is nothing there.

lines.zh: 誓言还在，说誓言的人不在了。
lines.en: The oath remains; the one who swore it does not.

lines.zh: 我把剑横在膝上，等天亮。
lines.en: I lay the sword across my knees and wait for dawn.

lines.zh: 有只虫子爬过我的指骨，随它。
lines.en: A bug crawls over my finger bones. Let it.

lines.zh: 我转向你，颈口对着你的方向。
lines.en: I turn, and the hollow of my neck faces you.

lines.zh: 你在看我的头吗，它早就不在了。
lines.en: Are you looking for my head? It left long ago.

lines.zh: 我看不见你，却知道你在发抖。
lines.en: I cannot see you, yet I know you are shaking.

lines.zh: 我的剑尖慢慢抬起来，指向你。
lines.en: My sword tip rises slowly and points at you.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味真重。
lines.en: The smell of iron on you is heavy.

lines.zh: 我把空荡的头盔正对着你。
lines.en: I aim the empty helmet straight at you.

lines.zh: 别盯着颈口看，那里只有黑。
lines.en: Do not stare at my neck; there is only black inside.

lines.zh: 你手里有火，往我这边照照。
lines.en: You carry fire; bring it closer and light me.

lines.zh: 我记得这种眼神，生前也见过。
lines.en: I know that look; I saw it in life too.

lines.zh: 我的铠甲认出了你腰间的剑。
lines.en: My armor recognizes the sword at your waist.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，铁靴却不动。
lines.en: You step back, but my iron boots do not move.

lines.zh: 我停顿很久，才想起该举剑。
lines.en: I stand a long while before remembering to raise my sword.

lines.zh: 铁甲凹了一块，里面的骨头没事。
lines.en: A plate dents, but the bones inside are fine.

lines.zh: 你砍中铠甲，火星溅了满脸。
lines.en: You strike the armor, and sparks splash your face.

lines.zh: 我不疼，只是退了一步。
lines.en: I feel no pain; I simply step back.

lines.zh: 剑差点脱手，我握紧了。
lines.en: My sword nearly slips, and I grip it tighter.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起死前那一击。
lines.en: This blow reminds me of the one that killed me.

lines.zh: 铠甲里的骨头响得很乱。
lines.en: The bones inside my armor rattle out of rhythm.

lines.zh: 你砍在颈口的空处，什么也没砍到。
lines.en: You swing at the hollow of my neck and hit nothing.

lines.zh: 我单膝跪下，又撑着剑站起来。
lines.en: I drop to one knee, then push up on my sword.

lines.zh: 我的披风破了一个口子。
lines.en: A new tear opens in my cloak.

lines.zh: 你力气不小，可惜砍错了地方。
lines.en: You hit hard, but you struck the wrong place.

lines.zh: 你手里的铁锭，勾起了旧日的记忆。
lines.en: The iron ingot in your hand stirs old memories.

lines.zh: 剑要磨了，我闻到了磨刀石的味道。
lines.en: My blade needs sharpening; I smell the whetstone.

lines.zh: 那口面包对我没用，但我多看了一眼。
lines.en: That bread does nothing for me, yet I glance again.

lines.zh: 别用金子试我，我早就不领饷了。
lines.en: Do not test me with gold; I stopped taking pay long ago.

lines.zh: 你的头盔不错，可惜我戴不了。
lines.en: Your helmet is fine, but I could never wear it.

lines.zh: 我伸手去接，才想起手在剑上。
lines.en: I reach for it and remember my hand holds a sword.

lines.zh: 那点火光很暖，我差点走近。
lines.en: That small fire is warm, and I almost stepped closer.

lines.zh: 铁片落在你脚边，我的铠甲响了一下。
lines.en: Metal scrap falls by your feet, and my armor answers.

lines.zh: 我很想要一个头，哪怕是假的。
lines.en: I want a head, even a false one.

lines.zh: 你把火把递来，我退了半步。
lines.en: You hold out the torch, and I back off half a step.

lines.zh: 铁甲撞上你，你被弹开了。
lines.en: Steel armor meets you, and you bounce away.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲磕到你，声音像敲钟。
lines.en: My pauldron strikes you with the sound of a bell.

lines.zh: 你撞进我怀里，只摸到冷铁。
lines.en: You run into me and touch only cold iron.

lines.zh: 让开些，我的剑很长。
lines.en: Step aside; my sword is long.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的披风，它早就烂了。
lines.en: You step on my cloak, which rotted long ago.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你的骨头响了一声。
lines.en: At that bump, one of your bones cracked.

lines.zh: 我侧身，铠甲缝隙夹住了你的衣角。
lines.en: I turn, and my armor seam catches your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我们擦肩，你闻到铁锈和土。
lines.en: We pass close, and you smell rust and earth.

lines.zh: 别推我，我站得不太稳。
lines.en: Do not push me; my footing is not that steady.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，你身上沾了墓土。
lines.en: After the bump, grave soil clings to you.

lines.zh: 我的新娘还在那座塔里等我。
lines.en: My bride still waits for me in that tower.

lines.zh: 无头的人，谈什么婚约。
lines.en: What marriage vow suits a headless man?

lines.zh: 我曾经发过誓，只对一个人。
lines.en: I once swore an oath to one person only.

lines.zh: 铠甲空着，心也空着。
lines.en: The armor is empty, and so is the heart.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，我的誓言还没散。
lines.en: Do not come so near; my oath has not faded.

lines.zh: 我记不清她的脸了，只记得铃声。
lines.en: I cannot recall her face, only the sound of bells.

lines.zh: 同类不会来，坟里的都不出声。
lines.en: My kind will not come; the grave keeps them quiet.

lines.zh: 我等的不是伴侣，是收剑的那天。
lines.en: I await not a partner, but the day I sheathe this blade.

lines.zh: 两个亡灵并肩，只会更冷。
lines.en: Two undead side by side only grow colder.

lines.zh: 这具身体早就不属于我了。
lines.en: This body stopped belonging to me long ago.

lines.zh: 我弯腰很费劲，所以从不捡东西。
lines.en: Bending over is hard for me, so I pick nothing up.

lines.zh: 剑在手里，别的都不重要。
lines.en: With a sword in hand, nothing else matters.

lines.zh: 地上那枚铁片，是我铠甲掉的。
lines.en: That scrap on the ground fell from my armor.

lines.zh: 我踢开挡路的碎石，没有捡。
lines.en: I kick the loose rubble aside instead of picking it up.

lines.zh: 你掉落的箭，我踩断了。
lines.en: I stepped on the arrow you dropped and snapped it.

lines.zh: 我的手套裂了，抓不住小物件。
lines.en: My gauntlet is torn and cannot grip small things.

lines.zh: 让它躺着，墓里的东西都这样。
lines.en: Let it lie there; grave things all end this way.

lines.zh: 我只捡回自己的碎片。
lines.en: I only gather the pieces of myself.

lines.zh: 弯腰时颈口会漏风，很冷。
lines.en: When I bend, wind leaks through my neck, and it is cold.

lines.zh: 财宝留给活人，我用不上。
lines.en: Leave the treasure to the living; I have no use.

lines.zh: 我抬起剑，铁与铁该有个了断。
lines.en: I raise my sword; iron owes iron a reckoning.

lines.zh: 你身上的活气，隔着十步都刺鼻。
lines.en: Your living scent stings from ten paces away.

lines.zh: 终于有人走进我的旧路。
lines.en: At last, someone walks my old road.

lines.zh: 我的剑在响，它认出你了。
lines.en: My sword is ringing; it recognizes you.

lines.zh: 铠甲下的骨头一起绷紧了。
lines.en: Every bone under this armor pulls tight.

lines.zh: 目标很近，近得能听见心跳。
lines.en: The target is close, close enough to hear a heartbeat.

lines.zh: 剑从土里出来，带起一串泥。
lines.en: The blade leaves the soil, trailing a string of mud.

lines.zh: 站住，报上你的名字。
lines.en: Halt, and tell me your name.

lines.zh: 颈口朝向你的那一刻，风停了。
lines.en: The wind stops the moment my neck turns to you.

lines.zh: 我等你很久了，久到忘了为什么。
lines.en: I have waited so long I forgot the reason.

lines.zh: 你拔剑的姿势很生疏。
lines.en: The way you draw your sword is clumsy.

lines.zh: 阴郁钥匙刃出鞘，声音很轻。
lines.en: The Somber Key Blade leaves its sheath almost silently.

lines.zh: 我数你的脚步，三步之后动手。
lines.en: I count your steps; I strike on the third.

lines.zh: 别跑，骑士追人很难看。
lines.en: Do not run; a knight chasing looks ridiculous.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，把这条路惊醒了。
lines.en: Your footsteps have woken this road.

lines.zh: 剑尖朝下，我先给你一次机会。
lines.en: Point down, I give you one chance first.

lines.zh: 我抬起头盔，里面空空的，别怕。
lines.en: I lift my helm; it is empty inside. Do not fear.

lines.zh: 又一个想拿钥匙的人，来吧。
lines.en: Another one after the key. Come, then.

lines.zh: 我追得不快，可我不会停。
lines.en: I do not chase fast, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 你绕到柱子后面，我绕另一边。
lines.en: You duck behind a pillar; I take the other side.

lines.zh: 铁靴踏地，整条走廊都在响。
lines.en: Iron boots strike the floor, and the whole hall echoes.

lines.zh: 我的剑拖在地上，划出白痕。
lines.en: My sword drags on the ground, leaving white scratches.

lines.zh: 跑吧，让我看看你还剩多少力气。
lines.en: Run, and let me see how much strength remains.

lines.zh: 我撞开挡路的木箱，没有绕路。
lines.en: I smash through a crate instead of going around.

lines.zh: 你的喘息声，替我指了路。
lines.en: Your panting shows me the way.

lines.zh: 骑士的追击，从来不靠速度。
lines.en: A knight's pursuit never depends on speed.

lines.zh: 我把剑举平，正好够到你。
lines.en: I level my blade, and it reaches you exactly.

lines.zh: 你踩松的石子滚回来，撞在我脚上。
lines.en: A stone you kicked rolls back against my boot.

lines.zh: 拐角到了，你的影子先露出来。
lines.en: The corner comes, and your shadow shows first.

lines.zh: 我一步一步来，你别指望我累。
lines.en: I go step by step; do not expect me to tire.

lines.zh: 这身盔甲很重，但我习惯了。
lines.en: This armor is heavy, but I am used to it.

lines.zh: 前面是死路，你听见了吗。
lines.en: That is a dead end ahead; do you hear it?

lines.zh: 我不看你的脚，我看你的肩。
lines.en: I do not watch your feet. I watch your shoulders.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，我停半步等你。
lines.en: You back to the wall; I halt half a step and wait.

lines.zh: 铁甲响一声，你便知道我近了。
lines.en: One clank of plate and you know I am closer.

lines.zh: 门槛太高，我抬腿迈了过去。
lines.en: The threshold is high; I lift my leg and step over.

lines.zh: 你换了三次方向，我都看见了。
lines.en: You changed direction three times. I saw each one.

lines.zh: 这条路我守过太久，比你熟。
lines.en: I have guarded this road too long to lose you here.

lines.zh: 剑锋落下，木盾裂成两半。
lines.en: My blade falls, and the wooden shield splits in two.

lines.zh: 我这一剑很慢，你却躲不开。
lines.en: My swing is slow, yet you cannot dodge it.

lines.zh: 铁刃划过，你的护甲响了一声。
lines.en: The iron edge passes, and your armor rings once.

lines.zh: 没有头的骑士，出手反而更准。
lines.en: A headless knight somehow strikes more precisely.

lines.zh: 我劈开空气，带起一股冷风。
lines.en: I cleave the air and drag a cold wind behind.

lines.zh: 这一记横扫，是我生前练的。
lines.en: This sweep is one I drilled while alive.

lines.zh: 剑背拍在你肩上，比刃更疼。
lines.en: The flat of my blade hits your shoulder harder than the edge.

lines.zh: 你若格挡，震得手臂发麻。
lines.en: If you block it, your arms will go numb.

lines.zh: 我刺出的角度很低，专找缝隙。
lines.en: My thrust comes low, hunting for the seams.

lines.zh: 铠甲撞上来，你退了整三步。
lines.en: My armor slams in, and you fly back three paces.

lines.zh: 我举起剑，颈口对着你。
lines.en: I raise the sword, my neck hollow aimed at you.

lines.zh: 这一下，就当是久违的问候。
lines.en: Consider this blow a greeting long overdue.

lines.zh: 我的剑很旧，刃口仍利。
lines.en: My sword is old, but the edge still bites.

lines.zh: 你流血了，我却闻不到。
lines.en: You are bleeding, and I cannot smell it.

lines.zh: 坟土裂开，铁甲自己站了起来。
lines.en: The grave soil splits, and the armor stands on its own.

lines.zh: 我从土里爬出，先找回我的剑。
lines.en: I climb from the earth and first recover my sword.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋碎了，空头盔滚了出来。
lines.en: The spawn egg breaks, and an empty helmet rolls out.

lines.zh: 月光落在铠甲上，我睁不开眼。
lines.en: Moonlight lands on my armor, and I cannot open my eyes.

lines.zh: 骨头在铁壳里重新拼好。
lines.en: Bones reassemble inside the iron shell.

lines.zh: 我站起来时，颈口漏出一声叹息。
lines.en: As I rise, a sigh leaks from my neck.

lines.zh: 旧路尽头，又多了个守夜的人。
lines.en: At the old road's end, another night watchman appears.

lines.zh: 铁锈味散开，我醒了。
lines.en: The smell of rust spreads, and I wake.

lines.zh: 我踩碎枯骨，站直了身子。
lines.en: I crush dry bones underfoot and straighten up.

lines.zh: 没有头，我也知道天亮了没。
lines.en: Headless, I still know whether dawn has come.

lines.zh: 铠甲缝里的土掉了一地。
lines.en: Soil spills from the seams of my armor.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里走出，剑先着地。
lines.en: I walk out of the shade, sword touching down first.

lines.zh: 这一片墓，暂时归我守。
lines.en: This graveyard is mine to watch for now.

lines.zh: 我扶正肩甲，开始找路。
lines.en: I straighten my pauldron and start looking for the road.

lines.zh: 碎碑压着我，我一片片掀开。
lines.en: Broken gravestones press on me; I heave them off one by one.

lines.zh: 这具骨架是新的，我用它站直。
lines.en: This skeleton is new. I use it to stand straight.

lines.zh: 土层松动，我的肩甲先露出来。
lines.en: The soil gives way; my pauldron surfaces first.

lines.zh: 有人在这一片喊过我的名字。
lines.en: Someone once called my name across this ground.

lines.zh: 我落地时，脚下的草全枯了。
lines.en: Where I land, the grass beneath me withers.

lines.zh: 夜色正好，够我把剑磨一遍。
lines.en: Good dark tonight. Enough to hone the blade once.

lines.zh: 火烤着铁甲，里面闷得像炉子。
lines.en: Fire heats the armor until it feels like an oven inside.

lines.zh: 我摔下台阶，铠甲替我挨了地。
lines.en: I fall down the stairs, and my armor takes the landing.

lines.zh: 水灌满头盔，我沉下去又站起来。
lines.en: Water fills the helmet; I sink, then stand again.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀飞了肩甲，我捡回来按上。
lines.en: The blast tears off my pauldron; I retrieve it and press it back.

lines.zh: 箭卡在甲缝里，我懒得拔。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my armor seam; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 咒语缠上骨头，我只觉得吵。
lines.en: A spell coils around my bones, and I only find it noisy.

lines.zh: 我早就不用吃饭了。
lines.en: I stopped needing meals long ago.

lines.zh: 雷劈中长剑，整具铠甲亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my sword, and the whole armor lights up.

lines.zh: 虚空把我吞了一半，剑还卡在边上。
lines.en: The void swallows half of me, my sword still stuck at the edge.
